sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission monitored and reviewed an internal investigation by WA Police into police contact with a family before the fatal Floreat family violence incident.
sentences.support:
it had decided to actively monitor the IAU investigation into the police 
response

sentences.text: The review considered police risk assessment, protection orders, seizure of firearms and recording of family contacts.
sentences.support:
Areas of primary interest in the investigation included the decision not to 
issue a Police Order

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the internal investigation was reasonable after an early concern was addressed, and that its findings and disciplinary outcomes were reasonably open.
sentences.support:
The Commission further considers that 
the findings made by IAU and the actions taken by WA Police in response 
to those findings are reasonably open.

sentences.text: The Commission separately began its own investigation into possible police misconduct concerning firearms licensing.
sentences.section: Bombara’s firearms licence: A Commission investigation
sentences.support:
The Commission has therefore commenced its own full investigation into 
the allegation of police misconduct

findings.quote:
Accordingly, the Commission concludes that the findings 
made by IAU were reasonably open.

The Commission also considers that the action taken by WA Police in 
disciplining officers who had breached the Code was reasonably open.

notes: No new Commission recommendations are listed. The 18 recommendations described in the report were made by the police Internal Affairs Unit and accepted by WA Police. The Commission’s separate firearms licensing investigation was ongoing at publication.
